description: This source file contains implementations for batch normalization and related normalization functions with support for batched tensor operations (via vmap). It includes batch rule helpers, backward passes, and plumbing functions that handle tensors with optional batch dimensions, along with dispatch key management for batched operations within the PyTorch functorch framework.
